title: How Reliable Are Automatic Evaluation Methods for Instruction-Tuned LLMs?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the alignment of automatic evaluation metrics (GPT-4, ROUGE-L, BERTScore) with human judgments using Pairwise Accuracy across English and Swedish tasks, demonstrating a drop in metric reliability for non-English languages.

Analyzing the distribution of scores assigned by GPT-4 as an evaluator compared to human ratings, revealing an excessively positive scoring tendency when gold references are not provided in the prompt.
Observing the LLM-as-a-judge's (GPT-4) tendency to assign higher scores to longer and more verbose model outputs, particularly when models over-generate text that receives lower human ratings.
